QuestInfo.name: [Cygnus Knights] Infiltrating the Secret Passage
QuestInfo.0: You and 10 Boogies have finished analyzing the Memory Chips. See what she has to say about them.
QuestInfo.1: The footage has revealed a secret tunnel to Black Wings' hideout. \r\n#b(If you fail, forfeit the quest and start it again.)
QuestInfo.2: Sneaking through the secret tunnel, you eavesdropped on the Puppeteer and the Master of Disguise. You then found yourself in danger, but the Resistance came to the rescue.
